## Project

### N1 Kanji 60-Day Challenge

A web application designed to help Japanese learners prepare for the JLPT N1 through a 60-day kanji learning challenge.

Main features:

- 60-day N1 Kanji challenge
- Kanji meanings
- Example words and sentences
- English and Myanmar translations
- Kanji readings and pronunciation
- Learned kanji marking
- Learning progress tracking

Development Tool:

- Google AI Studio
